name: Asphalt
description: Standard dry tarmac; optimal grip baseline, full tire smoke on heavy slip.

name: Concrete
description: Poured solid pavement; high grip with low rolling drag for grandstands and stadium bowls.

name: Curb
description: Apex kerb / rumble strip; subtle haptic vibration, high grip with mild drag.

name: Dirt
description: Compacted clay / gravel rally track; predictable sliding and drift control.

name: Gravel
description: Loose stone rally stage / runoff; moderate grip with heavy stone roost.

name: Grass
description: Standard off-track runoff; heavy rolling resistance penalizing corner cuts.

name: PackedSand
description: Packed sand desert ribbon; moderate flotation grip with sandy roost.

name: DeepSand
description: Deep desert dunes and arrestor beds; severe deceleration trap.

name: MudTrack
description: Compacted mud ribbon; drivable off-road course with brown roost plumes.

name: DeepMud
description: Viscous mud bog; heavy deceleration trap and deep ruts.

name: PackedSnow
description: Packed snow ribbon; winter rallying with white roost plumes.

name: DeepSnow
description: Deep snowbanks and drifts; severe rolling resistance barrier.

name: Water
description: Standing puddle hazard; hydroplaning risk, aqua spray plumes.

name: Oil
description: Oil slick hazard; extreme spin hazard, breaks rear traction instantly.

name: SheetIce
description: Glacial sheet ice; near-zero friction requiring studded tires.
